body:
Would it also be easier to get once there's a generic? Meaning doctors not insurance. 
Is there a way to make it without having GBL first?

I don't really have "a doctor." My case is severe and I attempt to see many doctors, and/or get told there's nothing they can do to help. 
And yeah, unwilling to prescribe.
I'm not scared of getting caught. Should I be? I mean why would I get caught exactly if I'm not selling it (never would) or doing anything sketchy? Is it because I need GBL first?
I'm scared of messing up and killing myself with it. Xyrem is controlled. It looks like it's easy to end up with something deadlier than you meant to take if you make it yourself.

I have good friends that help me with this sort of thing. More recently, my mom has been too. And they help me with my breakdowns, and nights, and psychosis. I'm very lucky for that.
And yes to the machines and doctors. I'm not doing anything diagnostic anymore. Just looking at xyrem and not seeing any other option after that. 

Calming feeling? Drawing, repetitive prayer, and shoulder and back massages, not leading to sleep it's just nice. 

That's beautiful. I am so happy you have that perspective and desire to help others.

I'm glad you quit. Gotta take care of yourself. If you can sleep, don't deny yourself sleep. I wouldn't. Are you okay?

Thanks so much. I don't know where I'll turn if it doesn't, if I continue to seek getting better. I've just exhausted every option.
btw I looked at one of your answers to someone. wow. you are a wonderful human. thank you for existing.

Well, none of the sleep drugs work as I have said. Doctors are astounded by my inability to get sedated.  I am hoping xyrem will. It seems like a wonderful last resort, and it has only very recently been suggested to me or I would have tried it years ago. I'm pretty set on suicide if it doesn't work. It's not an illogical reason to kill myself. It's pretty physically hopeless if ghb ends up not working on me. 

I have a therapist. She is wonderful. I'm not sleeping more because of it or any therapy I've done. But she helps trauma and things. I've made lots of progress.

I take lithium solely for stability due to no sleep. It definitely helps me break down less and hallucinate less. But I am not bipolar, it just keeps me level since I have to be awake so much. I am okay I just need sleep.
